step: B lifecycle: K for the intent lapse
rule: An intent lapses at whichever comes first: 3 scene breaks after its last affirmation (INTENT_LAPSE_SCENES) or K boundaries (INTENT_LAPSE_BOUNDARIES). K = 3 x the median boundaries per scene in the D1 corpus (v2.6 plan 02).
why: The D1 corpus did not exist when plan 06 was built. 8 is a placeholder, not a measurement.
toFix: From the D1 corpus: for each chat, boundaries between consecutive scene_summary derived records; take the median over all scenes; set PROVISIONAL_MEDIAN_BOUNDARIES_PER_SCENE to it (rename it MEDIAN_BOUNDARIES_PER_SCENE) and record the corpus id and the number here. The jest case 'K is three times the provisional median boundaries per scene' keeps the rule.
